messages:
maria: Quick thread — we need a compact launch playbook for the website that covers launch posts, benchmark narrative, webinar plan, and inbound form routing. It should map CTAs explicitly to Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Thoughts?

jake: I can own the launch posts cadence + landing copy. Do we want a standalone benchmark post that dives into latency and cost numbers or weave the highlights into the hero/secondary sections?

elsa: I'll pull the infra run metrics and boil them down to 3 short callouts (latency, throughput, security features). Can include an engineering quote for the benchmark post.

ryan: Webinar: target 30 min (20 demo + 10 Q&A) or 25/10. Panel: Product (maria), Eng (elsa), Customer (ask Glint), Ops (ryan). Demo should show smart routing/fallback and Dedicated onboarding flow.

maria: Messaging idea: single concise hero line that speaks to predictable inference. Under it, three action flows: Hosted -> "Try API (free credits)", Dedicated -> "Request reserved capacity", Private -> "Contact sales for VPC/on-prem". Hero stays mode-agnostic; each card has a 1-line clarifier.

olivia: For inbound routing, add hidden form fields: deployment_mode and interest_tier so SDRs can auto-route. Example hidden payload: {"deployment_mode":"private","interest":"enterprise"} (we'll store as strings).

jake: Suggested enums: deployment_mode = [hosted,dedicated,private]; interest = [eval,prod,enterprise]; region = [NA,EU,APAC]. We'll reflect those on the landing form config.

elsa: Draft benchmark blurbs (placeholders): "Hosted: ~85ms median token latency in hosted ops; Dedicated: reserved pools delivering 12k tokens/s steady throughput; Private: VPC + HSM/KMS for regulated workloads." I'll tighten for public copy.

maria: Launch post sequence: 1) Teaser (announce webinar & early access), 2) Benchmarks deep-dive (tech blog), 3) Customer spotlight (if confirmed), 4) Webinar reminder, 5) Launch day recap + how-to-get-started. Each post should point to the matching CTA per mode.

ryan: Panel prep: draft 6-8 focused Qs — routing policy examples, burst latencies, fallbacks across regions, Dedicated onboarding steps, security options for Private. I'll draft the Q list.

olivia: Implementation note: form routing mapping: if deployment_mode==private => enterprise-queue (team-enterprise@), dedicated => dedicated-sales queue, hosted => automated trial nurture funnel. I'll add mapping into our form builder.

maria: Deliverables and owners: Jake = 3 launch posts + webinar landing copy by Tue; Elsa = benchmark numbers + two short eng quotes; Olivia = wire form fields + routing rules; Ryan = confirm panelist customer + curate Qs; Maria = iterate hero/headlines and sample prompt snippets.

maria: Also want a tiny prompt library on each mode page (2 short examples/mode) so devs can paste and try immediately. Keep them concrete and short.

jake: I'll push first drafts to #copy-ops and link here when ready. :thumbsup:

mkt-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved Thu 10am PT — calendar invite sent to panelists.
